blocks.x: Connected machines to connected margin — service revenue attach up 3x
A construction-equipment manufacturer — Manufacturing & Industrial engagement delivered by a 22-person team over 18 months, Global scope, commercial model: build-run.

items: Installed base unconnected; service reactive; contract pricing on tradition.
Warranty leakage unexplained; failure knowledge anecdotal.
EU CRA product-security duties landing on unmanaged firmware estates.

blocks.x: The machine fleet platform brought provisioning, OTA and telemetry to the installed base; service economics (cost per machine, contract profitability) were instrumented on Forge; dispatch orchestration lifted first-time-fix; and the product-security program (SBOM, signed firmware, vulnerability SLAs) turned CRA duties into evidence.
The engagement was structured for transfer: named pod, documented runbooks, operator enablement, and a Compound phase that keeps challenger programs and conformance monitoring running after handover.

items: Sell-through +8 points and hero-SKU availability +24% — assortment intelligence
Yield +2.8 points, recalls scoped in minutes — quality and traceability program

blocks.x: Towers: IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust. Platforms: Achala Twinverse, Achala Forge, Achala Swarm.

items: the platform configuration patterns and the operator enablement curriculum, refined across engagements of this type.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
Ask for a reference conversation on this pattern — or map it to your estate in a briefing.
